prediction_text: (1) The King shall procure some forces out of Ireland, but they will come slowly and avail little against the Parliament. The Sun, lord of the 11th (the house of assistance/aid), is in the 7th in his exaltation applying to the cusp of the 11th but wanting six degrees of the partile aspect — aid is real but imperfect and delayed; and that Sun stands in direct opposition to the Ascendant (the Parliament), so the aid, when it comes, confronts Parliament without overthrowing it; the Moon, the King's significator, in Cancer in the 10th in her own house and increasing in light keeps his Majesty's own power entire meanwhile. (2) The Queen shall advance out of the North, but NOT prosper: her significatrix Saturn, lord of the 4th (the 7th from the 10th), is removing out of one sign into Aries, his fall — her condition worsens as she moves. The meeting: the Moon wants three or four degrees of the trine of Saturn — his Majesty shall meet her in about three to four weeks (week-scale coordinate: ~3–4 weeks).
basis: tradition: horary（卡面载明）。systems_used: horary。已载面：爱尔兰援军得否（主问一）、王后进军顺否与君王会合何时（主问二）。断项过闸：援军得而迟、效力有限←十一宫主太阳擢升趋临十一宫头尚差6°（未及分相）＋对冲上升（议会）；王后进而不顺←其象征土星换宫入白羊入弱；会合期←月亮距三合土星3–4°，定周尺度（战事行程），逢值路取约三至四周为主坐标，冲实／填实无候选。对象核：国王、王后、议会三方象征分栏对回。
